# Melee buffs for maximum damage

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_30_nukaknights-post-buffsmelee.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

*Update: As of June 30, 2020, the cooked buffs in connection with the "Carnivore" mutation are stronger*

*Meat:*

- 
 Sheepsquatch meat
- 
 Glowing flesh
- 
 Shining blood
- 
 Mutant dogs meat
- 
 Stingwing meat
- 
 Yao Guai meat

*ingredients*

- 
 Pepper (see map)
- 
 Mutaberries
- 
 Starlight berries
- 
 Carrots
- 
 Blood packs

*Ready cooked (buff with carnivore mutation):*

- 
 Leg of Mutton (+25% melee damage)
- 
 Mutton Pie (+37% melee damage)
- 
 Shining Steak (+25% melee damage)
- 
 Mutant Dog Stew (+37% melee damage)
- 
 Mutant Dog Clubs (+25% melee damage)
- 
 Stingwing Fillet (or Deathclaw) (+5 STR)
- 
 Deathclaw Steak (or Stingwing) (+5 STR)
- 
 Deathclaw Wellington (or Stingwing) (+8 STR)
- 
 Yao Guai Roast (+25% melee damage)
- 
 Yao Guai Ribs (+37% melee damage)

*Chems:*

- 
 X-Cell (+2 STR)
- 
 Overdrive (+15% melee damage)
- 
 Fury (+30% melee damage) or since the legendary perks: Super Chem MK2
- 
 Radshield (+300 RAD Res.) if no Secret Service armor
- 
 Luminous Blood Pack (+75 RAD Res.) if no Secret Service Armor

Note: X-Cell, Overdrive and Fury only stack if taken in this exact order.

*Alcohol:*

- 
 Whiskey (+6 STR with 3* party stallion)
- 
 Nukashine Vintage or Sugar Free (or Nuka Quantum for brewing Nukashine) (+100% melee damage)

*More:*

- 
 Unarmed bobbleheads (or melee HP) (+25% melee damage)
- 
 Melee Bobbleheads (or Unarmed Wp) (+20% Melee Damage)
- 
 Magazine: Grognak the Barbarian #1 (or U.S. Manual #8 (+15% melee damage): All melee weapons
- 
 Magazine: U.S. Covert Operations Manual #8 (or Grognak #1) (+25% Melee Damage): Unarmed/Knife only
